C1169.title: HackTricks Documents HTTP/2 Multiplexing as a Rate-Limit Bypass Method
C1169.summary: HackTricks documents that some gateways enforce quotas by TCP connection rather than by the number of HTTP/2 streams. A tester can reuse one TLS connection to send many independent requests concurrently while the gateway deducts only one request from the quota. The technique can also be combined with path confusion for high-speed OTP or credential attempts.
